items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: We all went out and bought new instruments. And there was a guy by the name of Carlos Gastell, who was running -- later he was the manager of Nat Cole...

ctx.x: What did you do for instruments instantly?

We all went out and bought new instruments. And there was a guy by the name of Carlos Gastell, who was running -- later he was the manager of Nat Cole and Peggy Lee and Mel Torme and Nellie Lutcher and all that.
